lead: V. S. Achuthanandan was an Indian politician, born on 20 October 1923 in Punnapra.
He died on 21 July 2025 in Thiruvananthapuram at the age of 101.
He has held the office of Chief Minister of Kerala and Member of the 14th Kerala Legislative Assembly and has been recognised with Padma Vibhushan and Padma Vibhushan in Public Affairs.
The sections that follow break down V. S. Achuthanandan's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

sections.heading: V. S. Achuthanandan — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: V. S. Achuthanandan was born on 20 October 1923 in Punnapra, and holds Indian nationality. He was given the name വേലിക്കകത്ത് ശങ്കരൻ അച്യുതാനന്ദൻ at birth and is publicly known as V. S. Achuthanandan.
He is recorded as speaking Malayalam and English.

sections.heading: V. S. Achuthanandan — Career and Professional Work
paras: V. S. Achuthanandan works primarily as a politician, trade unionist and freedom fighter.

He has held the following offices: Chief Minister of Kerala (2006–2011), Member of the 14th Kerala Legislative Assembly (2016–2021), Member of the 3rd Kerala Legislative Assembly (1967–1970), Member of the 4th Kerala Legislative Assembly (1970–1977), Member of the 11th Kerala Legislative Assembly (2001–2006) and Member of the 12th Kerala Legislative Assembly (2006–2011). He is affiliated with Communist Party of India.
